result.quote: Gaal son of Ebed and his brothers have come to Shechem and are stirring up the city against you.
result.reason: Verse 9:31 directly and uniquely supports both parts of the key. The wording naturally asks for the content of Zebul’s warning. However, the edit expands the original target: the source pair focuses on why Zebul sent the messengers—warning Abimelech that Gaal was inciting the city—whereas the edited item additionally requires that Gaal’s brothers had come with him to Shechem.
